privacy.intro: This page says, in plain words, what happens to your information in Loomora.

s1.title: Where your data lives
s1.body: Everything you add (to-dos, schedule items, check-offs and your streak) is saved on your own device, in your browser’s storage. Loomora does not send it to us or to anyone else.

s2.title: What we do not collect
s2.body: You do not need a name or an email to use Loomora. There are no ads, no trackers and no analytics, and we do not sell anything about you.

s3.title: Hosting
s3.body: The website is delivered by a hosting provider. Like most hosts, it may keep ordinary server logs, such as the time of a visit and the visitor’s IP address.

s4.title: Removing your data
s4.body: Clear this site’s data in your browser settings and Loomora forgets everything. We cannot restore it, because we never had it.

s5.title: Accounts later
s5.body: Accounts are not available yet. Before you are ever asked to save your plan online, this page will be updated to say what is stored and why.

terms.intro: These are the simple rules for using Loomora.

s1.title: Using Loomora
s1.body: Loomora is a free planner for your own to-dos and schedule. Use it for yourself and be kind to others.

s2.title: Your data
s2.body: Your plan is saved on your device only. If you clear your browser data, switch browsers or lose the device, your plan is gone, so keep that in mind.

s3.title: No promises
s3.body: Loomora is early software, provided as it is. It may have bugs or change, and we cannot promise it will always work or never lose data.

s4.title: Fair use
s4.body: Please do not try to break Loomora or use it to harm others.

s5.title: Changes
s5.body: These terms may change as Loomora grows. The date at the top shows the latest update.
